claims.claim: The dispatch-ref gate accepts only policy.main_ref and its exact stripped branch name, allowing refs/heads/main and main through the same existing admission path while rejecting every other ref value.
Exact dispatch input keys, strict selector validation, push admission, and remote terminal, conflict, signal, ancestry, and reviewed-carrier validation remain unchanged.

Synthetic regression coverage includes both main ref forms, remote admission, representative invalid refs, missing and extra input keys, and invalid selector values without introducing live events or private operational data.

The committed change modifies only src/aios_renew/terminal_attention.py and tests/test_terminal_attention.py and introduces no workflow, wake, lifecycle, retry, failover, publication, or roadmap behavior.
